correctionReview.note: Season membership and low-appearance candidates removed; large outstanding DOB, positions, all-team league starts checks remain.

manutd.notes: Recovered regular 4-4-2 rotation strikers Solskjær and Sheringham (15 PL starts each); LB Silvestre 30 starts above Irwin 25.

arsenal.notes: Henry/Kanu/Bergkamp all reached 23+ league starts and played 4-4-2 striker pairing at different times; retain third ST with recorded slot exception.

leeds.notes: Woodgate and Radebe primary CB, third Duberry; right defender Gary Kelly / Danny Mills selection requires appearances review.

liverpool.notes: Song returned to CB pool after 11v11 club archive showed 16 all-competition starts; Fowler and later arriving Heskey need striker quota review.

chelsea.notes: Ferrer played 25 league games, Melchiot 5 (one as sub); RB revised to Petrescu+Ferrer; position of wide midfielders remains unresolved.

leicester.notes: Elliott, Taggart, Sinclair/Gilchrist three-back variations: generic LB/RB blanks reflect football structure, not missed audit.

astonvilla.notes: Corrected James 29 (not 38), Enckelman 10; Merson 24 league starts and Carbone 22 restored; striker slot exception explicitly recorded.

bradford.notes: Statbunker PL-only table checked: Wetherall 38, Halle 37, Windass 36, O'Brien 36 starters; added 13-start LW Lee Sharpe, LB Andy Myers 10, striker Robbie Blake 15 (cap exception).
